metadata.question: Was the aerosol optical depth higher over Chiang Mai, Thailand during March 2024 than Bangkok, Thailand?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS MAIAC AOD daily 1 km (MODIS/061/MCD19A2) over March 2024 (2024-03-01 to 2024-04-01) for Chiang Mai and Bangkok buffers (20 km). If empty, try MODIS/006/MCD19A2, then widen window to 2024-02-15 to 2024-04-15. 
2. Masking strategy: For AOD, mask to valid physical range 0 < AOD < 5. Compute per-city monthly mean and valid pixel coverage.
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If image collection size is 0 after recovery → C1. If valid pixel count is 0 for either ROI → C2. If means are null/NaN or outside [0,5] → C3. Otherwise compare means: CM > BKK => A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const cmPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([98.9853, 18.7883]);
    const bkkPoint = ee.Geometry.Point([100.5018, 13.7563]);
    const bufferKm = 20;
    const cmROI = cmPoint.buffer(bufferKm * 1000);
    const bkkROI = bkkPoint.buffer(bufferKm * 1000);
    const unionROI = cmROI.union(bkkROI);

    const start = '2024-03-01';
    const end = '2024-04-01';
    const altStart = '2024-02-15';
    const altEnd = '2024-04-15';

    // Helper to get collection with fallbacks
    async function getCollection() {
      let used = 'MODIS/061/MCD19A2';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection(used)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(unionROI);
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();

      console.log(`Try ${used} (Mar): Images=${size}`);
      if (size === 0) {
        used = 'MODIS/006/MCD19A2';
        col = ee.ImageCollection(used)
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(unionROI);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        console.log(`Try ${used} (Mar): Images=${size}`);
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        // widen window
        col = ee.ImageCollection(used)
          .filterDate(altStart, altEnd)
          .filterBounds(unionROI);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        console.log(`Widened (${used}) Feb15–Apr15: Images=${size}`);
      }
      return { col, used, size };
    }

    const { col, used, size } = await getCollection();
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log('No images found in time/location after fallbacks.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Processing
    // Build masked AOD collection and monthly mean
    function maskAOD(img) {
      const aod = img.select('Optical_Depth_055');
      const valid = aod.gt(0).and(aod.lt(5));
      return aod.updateMask(valid).rename('AOD');
    }
    const maskedCol = col.map(maskAOD);
    const monthlyMean = maskedCol.mean(); // mean AOD over period

    // Helper to compute stats for ROI
    function statsForROI(roi) {
      const meanDict = monthlyMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const countDict = monthlyMean.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      const totalDict = ee.Image(1).rename('AOD').reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      return ee.Dictionary({
        mean: meanDict.get('AOD'),
        validCount: countDict.get('AOD'),
        totalCount: totalDict.get('AOD')
      });
    }

    const results = ee.Dictionary({
      cm: statsForROI(cmROI),
      bkk: statsForROI(bkkROI)
    });

    const out = await results.getInfo();
    const cm = out.cm;
    const bkk = out.bkk;

    // 3. Validation & Final Answer logic
    function isInvalid(val) {
      return val === null || isNaN(val) || !isFinite(val) || val < 0 || val > 5;
    }

    const cmValid = cm.validCount || 0;
    const bkkValid = bkk.validCount || 0;
    const cmTotal = cm.totalCount || 0;
    const bkkTotal = bkk.totalCount || 0;
    const cmMean = cm.mean;
    const bkkMean = bkk.mean;

    // Print concise evidence
    console.log(`Dataset: ${used}, Images: ${size}`);
    console.log(`ChiangMai MeanAOD: ${cmMean !== null ? cmMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'} | ValidPx: ${cmValid}/${cmTotal} (${cmTotal ? (100*cmValid/cmTotal).toFixed(1) : '0.0'}%)`);
    console.log(`Bangkok   MeanAOD: ${bkkMean !== null ? bkkMean.toFixed(3) : 'null'} | ValidPx: ${bkkValid}/${bkkTotal} (${bkkTotal ? (100*bkkValid/bkkTotal).toFixed(1) : '0.0'}%)`);

    if (cmTotal === 0 || bkkTotal === 0 || cmValid === 0 || bkkValid === 0) {
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (isInvalid(cmMean) || isInvalid(bkkMean)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const delta = cmMean - bkkMean;
    console.log(`Delta(CM-BKK): ${delta.toFixed(3)}`);

    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err.message || err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
